source.label: BLS September employment
source.limitation: Browser tool retrieved release; direct urllib download failed. Revisions can alter interpretation; no consensus surprise claimed.

facts: Primary fact: September payrolls rose 29,000 and unemployment was 4.2%. Wage growth was 0.1% monthly / 3.0% yearly; combined July/August revisions were -60,000.
schedule_notes: October 5–9 has no listed BLS selected releases. CPI scheduled October14 08:30ET; PPI October15 08:30ET. Extracted through web tool; no raw BLS HTML captured.
